### Constraints

  Props: value: DateRange, onChange: (DateRange) => void
  DateRange = { from: Date | undefined; to: Date | undefined }

  drawdown.tsx — AreaChart, x=date, y=drawdown_pct, ReferenceLine at max drawdown
